name: OmaFortiVPN
author: Augusto Bauer Domingos
description: FortiGate SSL VPN indicator and panel for the Omarchy bar, on top of openfortivpn. The icon stays in the bar, dimmed while disconnected; middle click connects or disconnects, and its panel shows the tunnel, switches profiles, and says why the last connection failed or dropped. Connecting opens a floating terminal because the password and 2FA token have to be typed.

barWidget.description: Show the FortiGate tunnel, connect to a profile, and disconnect from a panel.

schema.label: Keep the icon visible while disconnected
